verdict.rationale: Lever's Automation Hub is described as handling routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing, and advancing candidates without manual work. Advanced Nurture automates outreach and follow-ups, and webhooks with event configuration let external systems react to events in the background. The evidence is marketing-level only, so the depth of setup is unclear. Missing for 10: documentation of how automation rules, triggers, and conditions are configured; any AI or agent-driven autonomous behavior beyond rule-based tasks; independent or hands-on corroboration.
